regions.label: Page (DashboardGrid) — keeps its configured column count (2, every layout.yaml page) at phone width too; superseded from an earlier 1-col-phone draft, see components/behavior

components.grid rows below the breakpoint: GAP:ruled:d8ef0463 — no explicit grid-template-rows from JS below the tablet/phone breakpoint; grid-auto-rows: minmax(var(--card-min-h), 1fr) with no explicit row template lets CSS Grid derive the row count from the actual number of cards, distributed across the fixed column count; an equal share of the screen, never below --card-min-h (k7-phone-page-scroll, [node:97c338d8]) — zero JS resize listener needed
components.grid columns: GAP:ruled:db145886 — superseded from an earlier @media(max-width:767px) column-count-forced-to-1 override: the phone media query no longer overrides grid-template-columns at all, so the base rule's repeat(var(--deck-cols,3), ...) applies at phone width too, same as desktop/tablet

states.desktop/tablet, N columns: unchanged — explicit --deck-cols/--deck-rows from layout.yaml's declared column count, as today
states.phone, N columns, fewer cards than fit n: each card gets more height than an equal 1/rows share needs — no visible change from today's single-card-per-row case
states.phone, N columns, more cards than fit na: the page itself scrolls vertically (k7-phone-page-scroll, human ruling [node:97c338d8], reversing [node:1580e5d3]'s no-page-scroll rule): cards share the screen evenly only while that share is at least --card-min-h (240px); below it each card keeps the floor and the page grows. Header and status footer stay fixed; the document never scrolls. List cards keep their own inner scroll. The pager ignores vertical drags (pager.ts#resolveDragAxis). Column count is still the layout's own, per [node:db145886].

behavior: Column count comes from the same --deck-cols the desktop/tablet grid already uses (layout.yaml's declared column count) — the phone media query no longer overrides it, reversing an earlier single-column-at-phone draft once a dense page (SYSTEM, 6 cards) was found to clip glance-tier text outright even after every other phone-width squeeze fix. [node:db145886]

Row count is never JS-computed below the breakpoint — it falls out of the number of grid children divided across the (now phone-preserved) column count automatically, so it cannot drift out of sync with the column count again.

Server-driven breakpoints from the theme's own breakpointTabletPx/breakpointDesktopPx remain a separate, blocked-on-v1/v2-schema-adoption follow-up, [node:611bc3d8] — the hardcoded 767px literal is unchanged.

regions.label: status group (shell-status: changelog button, status text, cursor) — drops to its own row when tight

components.header row: GAP:ruled:538d1960 — flex-wrap: wrap added to .shell-head, a direct application of DESIGN.md section 6.1's already-documented 'rows wrap before they crush' rule, never applied to this specific header before now

states.phone, tight width: the whole shell-status group (button + status text + cursor) drops to its own row below the title; the title itself stays single-line since it no longer competes for width on the same row

behavior: No JS involved — pure flex-wrap. If shell-status's own three children still don't fit one line at 375px, the same treatment applies one level down (verify live before considering this screen done).

components.readout text: GAP:ruled:538d1960 — font-size drops from --glance-md to --glance-sm at the phone breakpoint via a viewport-width media query; not container-query-based (Safari 15 floor), not clamp()/vw-based. Corrected at /gw-plan-review: this is the first viewport-width typography swap in this codebase, not a copy of SIATKA's own --glance-sm override (that one is an unconditional shadow-DOM cascade for nested cells, unrelated to breakpoints)

states.finished: same sizing rule, color still var(--warn) via the existing .readout.finished class
states.idle (preset picker): already correct — flex:1 1 auto; min-height:0; overflow-y:auto on .presets, unaffected by this screen

behavior: No scroll affordance for the readout — a single centered number has nothing meaningful to scroll to. Shrinking is the only correct response to a squeezed cell.

components.art block: GAP:ruled:97d0c4ba — corrected at /gw-plan-review, verified via a real headless-Chrome test: flex:1 1 auto; min-height:0 on .art alone is a no-op, since Card.svelte's .card-body is not itself display:flex. Fix: wrap the card-body content in a new <div class="wrap"> (display:flex; flex-direction:column; height:100%; min-height:0), matching K7ShoppingList's .wrap / Timer's .idle-wrap exactly — .art's own flex:1 1 auto; min-height:0 then does something, and its existing overflow:auto activates

states.content taller than its cell (a long gen: internal scroll, same as Timer's idle preset list; on a phone the page itself also scrolls when its cards do not fit (k7-phone-page-scroll, [node:97c338d8])

behavior: Purely mechanical CSS fix — no new visual design, no new token.
